entries.text: I feel extremely inconvenienced . I wish I could go back and time and change my decisions so I’m not in the situation that I’m currently in . I’m grateful that my inconvenience is minor and temporary , but I’m still annoyed .

I’m feeling a little tired but I feel like I have a lot of things that I’m looking forward to doing . I finished my outstanding tasks that I was dreading . I feel relieved and know that I can rest soon .

I’m tired but I feel relaxed . I finally have free time . I am looking forward to eating food and unwinding . My day is finally over and I don’t have any outstanding obligations . I’m grateful that I didn’t have a stressful day .

I feel exhausted and drained . I feel like I need a nap . I want to sleep . I can’t wait to rest and relax . I’m also frustrated because piece of the back of my phone glass is falling off . I hope it doesn’t break more .

I recently had a scary motorcycle accident and I’m still recovering . I feel very shaken up and afraid to ride my motorcycle again . I’m feeling very sad right now because of the incident . I also feel uneasy .

I’m feeling relaxed and at ease . I’m not too stressed about anything at the moment . I’m still a bit sick which is frustrating but my symptoms seem to have improved . I am looking forward to getting rest and getting better .
